rows.question: Identify a list of genes expressed in lung cancer
rows.pred_sql:
WITH gene_symbol_to_ensembl_mapping AS (
  SELECT
    x.ensembl_gene_id AS ensembl_gene_id,
    x.gene_symbol     AS gene_symbol,
    x.speciesid       AS speciesid
  FROM xref_gene_ensembl x
  WHERE x.ensembl_gene_id IS NOT NULL
    AND x.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
),
cancer_tissue_uberon_map AS (
  SELECT
    ct.doid AS doid,
    ct.uberon_anatomical_id AS uberon_anatomical_id
  FROM cancer_tissue ct
  WHERE ct.doid IS NOT NULL
    AND ct.uberon_anatomical_id IS NOT NULL
),
gene_expression_in_anatomical_tissue AS (
  SELECT
    he.ensembl_gene_id,
    he.uberon_anatomical_id,
    he.uberon_developmental_id,
    he.expression_level_gene_relative,
    he.expression_level_anatomical_relative,
    he.call_quality,
    he.expression_rank_score,
    he.expression_score,
    ae.name AS anatomical_entity_name,
    ae.description AS anatomical_entity_description
  FROM healthy_expression he
  LEFT JOIN anatomical_entity ae
    ON he.uberon_anatomical_id = ae.id
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  m.gene_symbol,
  g.ensembl_gene_id,
  g.uberon_anatomical_id,
  g.anatomical_entity_name,
  g.expression_level_gene_relative,
  g.expression_score,
  g.expression_rank_score,
  g.call_quality
FROM gene_expression_in_anatomical_tissue g
JOIN gene_symbol_to_ensembl_mapping m
  ON g.ensembl_gene_id = m.ensembl_gene_id
JOIN cancer_tissue_uberon_map c
  ON g.uberon_anatomical_id = c.uberon_anatomical_id
WHERE (
    c.doid = 3904
    OR (g.anatomical_entity_name IS NOT NULL AND g.anatomical_entity_name ILIKE '%lung%')
    OR (g.anatomical_entity_name IS NOT NULL AND g.anatomical_entity_name ILIKE '%pulmonary%')
)
AND g.call_quality = 'present'
ORDER BY g.expression_score DESC NULLS LAST, g.expression_rank_score ASC
LIMIT 100

rows.question: Show biomarker gene symbol and description for 'breast cancer'
rows.pred_sql:
WITH biomarker_row_level AS (
  SELECT
    b.id,
    b.gene_symbol,
    b.biomarker_description,
    b.biomarker_id,
    b.test_is_a_panel
  FROM biomarker b
),
-- candidate links from various tables/heuristics to diseases
biomarker_to_disease_link_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id_internal,
    b.biomarker_id AS biomarker_id,
    b.gene_symbol AS biomarker_gene_symbol,
    b.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description,
    d.id::bigint AS disease_id,
    d.name AS disease_name,
    lt.link_type
  FROM biomarker b
  JOIN LATERAL (
    -- 1) biomarker.biomarker_id exactly matches a disease.name
    SELECT d1.id, 'explicit_biomarker_id' AS link_type
    FROM disease d1
    WHERE b.biomarker_id IS NOT NULL
      AND d1.name IS NOT NULL
      AND d1.name = b.biomarker_id

    UNION

    -- 2) FDA-test rows that include a doid for biomarker's FDA record (match biomarker.id to biomarker_fda.id)
    SELECT f.doid::bigint AS id, 'explicit_fda_test_doid' AS link_type
    FROM biomarker_fda bf
    LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_test f
      ON f.test_trade_name = bf.test_trade_name
      AND f.test_submission = bf.test_submission
    WHERE bf.id = b.id
      AND f.doid IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    -- 3) differential expression linking by gene_symbol -> doid
    SELECT de.doid::bigint AS id, 'gene_expression_differential' AS link_type
    FROM differential_expression de
    WHERE de.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
      AND b.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
      AND de.gene_symbol = b.gene_symbol

    UNION

    -- 4) free-text heuristic: gene_symbol appears in disease.name
    SELECT d2.id, 'gene_name_text_match' AS link_type
    FROM disease d2
    WHERE b.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
      AND d2.name IS NOT NULL
      AND POSITION(b.gene_symbol IN d2.name) > 0
  ) lt ON true
  JOIN disease d ON d.id = lt.id
)

SELECT DISTINCT
  b.id,
  b.gene_symbol,
  b.biomarker_description
FROM biomarker_row_level b
LEFT JOIN biomarker_to_disease_link_candidates link
  ON b.id = link.biomarker_id_internal
LEFT JOIN disease d
  ON link.disease_id = d.id
WHERE
  -- match disease name exactly (case-insensitive)
  (d.name IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(d.name) = 'breast cancer')
  -- or free-text mentions in biomarker fields
  OR (b.biomarker_description IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(b.biomarker_description) LIKE '%breast cancer%')
  OR (b.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(b.gene_symbol) LIKE '%breast cancer%')
ORDER BY b.gene_symbol NULLS LAST

rows.question: Get all distinct biomarker EDRN phases
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  CASE
    WHEN phase IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE
      CASE lower(regexp_replace(trim(phase), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))
        WHEN '' THEN NULL
        WHEN 'i' THEN 'phase i'
        WHEN 'phase i' THEN 'phase i'
        WHEN 'phase 1' THEN 'phase i'
        WHEN 'phase i/ii' THEN 'phase i-ii'
        WHEN 'phase i-ii' THEN 'phase i-ii'
        WHEN 'phase ii' THEN 'phase ii'
        WHEN 'phase 2' THEN 'phase ii'
        WHEN 'ii' THEN 'phase ii'
        WHEN 'phase iii' THEN 'phase iii'
        WHEN 'phase 3' THEN 'phase iii'
        WHEN 'iii' THEN 'phase iii'
        WHEN 'phase iv' THEN 'phase iv'
        WHEN 'iv' THEN 'phase iv'
        WHEN 'preclinical' THEN 'preclinical'
        WHEN 'discovery' THEN 'preclinical'
        WHEN 'na' THEN NULL
        WHEN 'not applicable' THEN NULL
        WHEN 'unknown' THEN NULL
        WHEN 'clinical' THEN 'clinical'
        ELSE lower(regexp_replace(trim(phase), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))
      END
  END AS phase
FROM biomarker_edrn
WHERE phase IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY phase
